Messages.Author: talonz
Messages.Body:
If you strike with the default hand strike, is the damage done also
declared at that point?

Body arsenal (superior vicissitude) is queer this way, if you play it
pre strike, it is obvious that you will strike for +1 strength and agg.
But if you play it after strike declaration but before strike
resolution, do you get to add the strength modifier at this point?

G

Messages.Author: Arden McBathan
Messages.Body:
Why wouldn't you? You declare a "Strike: Strength Damage" and not a
"Strike: X Damage, where X is the vamp's strength when playing this
card/announcing this strike".
Damage is gonna be the strenght you have during the solution.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
talonz wrote:
> If you strike with the default hand strike, is the damage done also
> declared at that point?

No. See also declaring a strike with a .44 and later playing ammo.

> Body arsenal (superior vicissitude) is queer this way, if you play it
> pre strike, it is obvious that you will strike for +1 strength and agg.
> But if you play it after strike declaration but before strike
> resolution, do you get to add the strength modifier at this point?

Yes.
And you also get the aggravated modifier at that point.
